title: The functional A ↦ ∫_{A×G(N,n)} g dm is a Borel measure in A (Simon 8.5.10 proof, step 2: tilt term)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, let m be a measure on ℝ^N × G(N,n) (G(N,n) = Grassmannian N n, product σ-algebra), and let g : ℝ^N × G(N,n) → [0,∞] be an arbitrary function. Then there is a measure τ on ℝ^N such that τ(A) = ∫⁻_{A × G(N,n)} g dm (lower Lebesgue integral over A ×ˢ univ) for every measurable A ⊆ ℝ^N.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (m : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (g : Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n → ℝ≥0∞), ∃ τ : Measure (Euclidean N), ∀ A : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet A → τ A = ∫⁻ z in A ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), g z ∂m
